landing.home.meta_description: Access Mobile Money exchange, airtime, data, gift cards, fuel vouchers and supported everyday payment services with OnwaysPay.
landing.hero.eyebrow: One app. More ways to pay.
landing.hero.title: Move, pay, and connect with confidence.
landing.hero.body: Exchange Mobile Money, purchase airtime and data, buy gift cards, access fuel vouchers, and manage everyday payments from one simple app.
landing.services.heading: Everything you need in one payment center.
landing.services.intro: Practical services designed for everyday life, brought together in one clear mobile experience.
landing.services.money.title: Mobile Money Exchange
landing.services.money.body: Exchange between supported Mobile Money networks and countries, with saved recipients, history, and transaction tracking.
landing.services.airtime.title: Credit & Internet
landing.services.airtime.body: Purchase airtime and mobile data for supported operators.
landing.services.gift.title: Gift Cards
landing.services.gift.body: Purchase supported international digital gift cards using Mobile Money.
landing.services.fuel.title: Fuel Vouchers
landing.services.fuel.body: Buy and send digital fuel vouchers, then redeem them through participating stations.
landing.services.bills.title: Bill Payments
landing.services.bills.body: Pay supported utility bills when partner invoice services become available.
landing.services.qr.title: QR Scanning
landing.services.qr.body: Scan supported QR codes, including fuel-voucher redemption codes.
landing.services.visa.title: Visa Card Links
landing.services.visa.body: Link supported Visa cards to view provider-available balances, history, and recharge options.
landing.how.heading: From choice to confirmation in three clear steps.
landing.how.intro: A simple path from choosing a service to receiving a clear transaction update.
landing.how.one.title: Create your account
landing.how.one.body: Register and securely verify your information.
landing.how.two.title: Choose a service
landing.how.two.body: Select exchange, payment, top-up, voucher, or another available service.
landing.how.three.title: Confirm with a partner
landing.how.three.body: Review the details and authorize payment through the supported licensed provider.
landing.coverage.heading: Built for payments across African markets.
landing.coverage.body: Availability depends on the licensed partner, service, and country.
landing.trust.heading: Your payment stays with the payment provider.
landing.trust.body: OnwaysPay is a service orchestration platform, not a financial institution. OnwaysPay does not receive, hold, or store customer funds. Financial transactions are executed directly by licensed payment partners and service providers.
landing.trust.one: Sensitive financial processing remains with authorized partners.
landing.trust.three: Follow progress with transaction history and status tracking.
landing.security.intro: Clear responsibilities and partner-led financial processing protect every interaction.
landing.faq.heading: Questions, answered clearly.
landing.faq.intro: Useful answers about payments, coverage, tracking, and vouchers.
landing.faq.a1: No. OnwaysPay is a service orchestration platform, not a bank or financial institution.
landing.faq.a2: No. Funds are processed directly by licensed payment partners and service providers.
landing.faq.q3: Which Mobile Money networks are supported?
landing.faq.a3: Available networks depend on your country and current partner coverage.
landing.faq.q4: Can I use OnwaysPay in another country?
landing.faq.a4: Cross-country services are available only on supported routes and through available partners.
landing.faq.q5: How do I track an exchange?
landing.faq.a5: Open your transaction history and select an exchange to view its latest status.
landing.faq.a6: Buy or send a digital voucher, then use its QR code at a participating station.
landing.faq.q7: What should I do if a provider transaction remains pending?
landing.faq.a7: Check the status in your history and follow the support guidance shown for that transaction.
landing.contact.heading: We are here to help.
landing.contact.intro: Contact the OnwaysPay team for product, partnership, or transaction support.
landing.contact.support_body: Support contact details will be published here once the channel is ready.
landing.contact.hours_body: Support availability will be announced with the official contact channel.
landing.cta.title: Everyday payments, one simpler experience.
landing.cta.body: Download OnwaysPay and access supported payment services from one secure, easy-to-use platform.
landing.footer.about: A mobile-first platform bringing supported everyday payment services into one clear interface.
landing.footer.disclaimer: Payments are processed by licensed partners. OnwaysPay does not hold customer funds.
